findings.summary: Plan and verify-retired hold one serializable locked assessment through transaction resolution; the controlled recovery-race regression passes.
Rollback and close failures produce one content-free closed report, including indeterminate classification after a completed commit.
Every attempted commit remains indeterminate with exit 3 when rollback or close also fails; combined-failure regressions never downgrade to refused or Pass.
The optional initiative directory was removed instead of changing the actively claimed package registry; the reduced candidate retains all required operator safety instructions.
